solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Correspondence, result of an accident?

definitions.meaning: agreement or matching up, as when two accounts correspond
something that happens by chance rather than design, a fluke

explanation.surface: A letter wonders whether it arose from some mishap.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a matching of facts or dates, and a chance concurrence of events with no planning behind it.

clue.text: Humble subject

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to humble is to defeat or bring low
as a verb, to subject is to bring under one's control

explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean to overcome and dominate, as an army does a nation it defeats.

clue.text: It plays a small part in the big picture

definitions.text: It plays a small part in the big picture

parts.words: It plays a small part in the big picture
parts.note: reads like a bit-part actor in a film, but describes a small image set within a larger picture or map

explanation.surface: A minor actor has a walk-on role in an epic film.
explanation.definitionFit: A small map or illustration placed within a larger one is, literally, a small part of the big picture.

clue.text: Burglar jokes with servant

parts.note: cracks are jokes or wisecracks
a man is a manservant

explanation.surface: A housebreaker shares a laugh with the butler.
explanation.definitionFit: Cracksman is an old word for a safe-breaker or burglar, one who cracks safes.

clue.text: Appreciates archaeological excavations

definitions.meaning: in slang, to dig something is to like or appreciate it
an archaeological site under excavation is called a dig

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys the work at a historic excavation site.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang verb for enjoying, plus the noun for sites where archaeologists excavate, in its plural form.

clue.text: Shipping company that was floated using the double-entry system

definitions.text: Shipping company that was floated using the double-entry system

parts.words: Shipping company that was floated using the double-entry system
parts.note: sounds like a firm launched on the stock market with tidy bookkeeping, but describes the biblical vessel whose animals boarded two by two

explanation.surface: A shipping firm went public with sound accounting practices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Floated' suggests a share launch and 'double-entry' bookkeeping; in fact the boat was launched and the animals entered in pairs.
explanation.definitionFit: The vessel in Genesis carried a company of creatures, floated on the Flood, with each species entering in pairs.

clue.text: Uplifting holy books are an inspiration to poets

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting up means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of holy books
taken as written

explanation.surface: Inspiring scriptures are said to move poets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uplifting' turns both pieces together: OTARE read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato was the Greek Muse of lyric and love poetry, so a source of inspiration to poets.

clue.text: New singlet produces prickling sensations

indicators.note: making something new of the word singlet means rearranging its letters

explanation.surface: A new vest causes an itchy feeling on the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Tingles are slight stinging or prickling feelings on the skin.

clue.text: Complete gathering of men for a board meeting

definitions.text: Complete gathering of men for a board meeting

parts.words: Complete gathering of men for a board meeting
parts.note: reads like full attendance of directors at a board meeting, but means all the pieces needed for a game on a chequered board

explanation.surface: Every director turned up for the company's board meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: Chess pieces are traditionally called 'men', and the 'board' is the chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A full collection of chessmen with which two players meet over a board is a complete set.

clue.text: Lost again maybe, and longing to get home

indicators.note: maybe signals that the words lost again are a possible rearrangement of the answer

explanation.surface: A traveller, astray once more, yearns to be back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Nostalgia originally meant homesickness, a yearning to return home.

clue.text: He splits a couple of poles made of wood

indicators.note: something that splits a pair goes between them, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: S and N are the abbreviations for the South and North poles
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man chops up two posts made of timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A couple of poles' gives A plus the two poles S and N; 'He' goes between the S and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashen as an adjective can mean made of ash, the timber of the ash tree.

clue.text: Clever people are quick on it

definitions.text: Clever people are quick on it

parts.words: Clever people are quick on it
parts.note: alludes to the idiom for being fast to understand, 'quick on the' followed by the word wanted

explanation.surface: Smart folk grasp things rapidly.
explanation.definitionFit: Uptake means comprehension; sharp minds are said to be quick at understanding in the stock idiom.

clue.text: Marriage or adoption

definitions.meaning: a wedding or betrothal, the old sense of being espoused
taking up and supporting a cause or idea

explanation.surface: A form asks whether one has married or adopted a child.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a wedding, and also the embracing or championing of a cause or belief.

clue.text: Carry on with one's CV, perhaps

definitions.meaning: to begin again or continue after a pause
a summary of one's career, the American word for a curriculum vitae

explanation.surface: Someone keeps working on their job application.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means continue after interruption; as a noun, with accents, a career summary.

clue.text: Girl to sign for earnings

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally or Sarah
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A girl puts her name to a pay agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Salaries are fixed regular payments for work, hence earnings.

clue.text: Disturbing poster seen around street results in objections

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are placed around another piece
disturbing the word poster means jumbling its letters

explanation.surface: An offensive poster put up on a street draws complaints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disturbing' makes the jumbled run PROTES, and 'around' wraps it round the street abbreviation; 'seen' and 'results in' are only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Protests are expressions of objection or disapproval.

clue.text: Overturned, though given a warning first

definitions.meaning: tipped over and knocked off its place
informed in advance, given a secret tip

explanation.surface: A vehicle flipped over, but its driver had been warned.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally knocked off by tipping, and idiomatically given advance information or a warning.

clue.text: She-devil out to produce disorder

indicators.note: out signals the letters of she-devil are put out of order

explanation.surface: A wicked woman sets out to cause chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: To dishevel is to make untidy or throw into disorder, especially hair or clothes.

clue.text: Electro-magnet needed when old one is moved

indicators.note: moved signals that the letters are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A new electromagnet is required once the old one has been relocated.
explanation.definitionFit: A solenoid is a wire coil that acts as a magnet when current flows through it.

clue.text: Hold up American during pay-out

indicators.note: one piece occurs during the other, so it is set inside it

parts.note: to spend is to pay out money

explanation.surface: A US citizen delays a payment.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspend is to hold up, defer or postpone something.

clue.text: Boy about to pocket ball with unerring accuracy

indicators.note: the first piece goes about, that is around, the second

parts.note: a son is a boy
in snooker, to pot is to send a ball into a pocket

explanation.surface: A lad at the snooker table is about to sink a ball with perfect aim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like 'on the point of', but it is the container signal; snooker players pot balls into pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Spot-on means exactly right, precisely accurate.

clue.text: He must have a supporter, may get one in me

indicators.note: may get suggests the letters of one in me could be made into another word

explanation.surface: Someone needing backing may find it in the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A nominee needs someone to propose or second the nomination, a supporter.

clue.text: Honest view about retrograde art

indicators.note: the first piece goes about, around, the second

parts.note: a sight is a view

indicators.note: retrograde means moving backwards, so the word art is reversed

explanation.surface: A critic gives a frank opinion on backward-looking art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retrograde' gives TRA, and 'about' tells you the view goes round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight means honest and frank, as in a straight answer.

clue.text: Great Asian long-distance runner

parts.note: sounds like a marathon athlete, but a 'runner' is a river, and this one flows a long way through Asia

explanation.surface: A celebrated Asian athlete runs marathons.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indus is one of Asia's great rivers, flowing some 3,000 kilometres from Tibet to the Arabian Sea.

clue.text: Show improvement with respect to criminal record

parts.note: re means concerning or with respect to
form is British slang for a criminal record

explanation.surface: An offender's past record suggests they should mend their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To reform is to improve one's behaviour or conduct.

clue.text: Giant group of stars

definitions.meaning: in Greek myth, a giant hunter
a constellation named after that hunter

explanation.surface: A massive cluster of stars appears in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion was a giant huntsman of Greek legend, and the constellation bearing his name is prominent in winter skies.

clue.text: Finished off the cake — from the freezer?

definitions.meaning: put sugar topping on a cake as the last step
frozen solid, as something taken out of the freezer

explanation.surface: Someone completes a cake fresh from the freezer.
explanation.definitionFit: Means topped with sugar frosting, and also chilled or frozen.

clue.text: Don't go on about me to improve the matter

indicators.note: the first piece goes about, around, the second

parts.note: to end is to stop, not go on
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stop talking about themselves to make things better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Matter' here means written material, a text.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct and improve a text, the written matter.

clue.text: Two men of a bygone age

parts.note: Victor is a man's name
Ian is a man's name

explanation.surface: A pair of gentlemen from an earlier era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two men' is one phrase giving two names.
explanation.definitionFit: Victorian means belonging to the reign of Queen Victoria, so old-fashioned or from a past era.

clue.text: Such action will not be offensive or illegal

definitions.text: Such action will not be offensive or illegal

parts.words: Such action will not be offensive or illegal
parts.note: describes force used only to protect oneself, not as an attack, which the law excuses

explanation.surface: A statement about which deeds are neither rude nor unlawful.
explanation.definitionFit: Protecting oneself from attack is defensive by nature and a recognised legal justification for force.
